summary: The filing is a Form 6-K from AIOS Tech Inc. reporting the results of an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders held on May 29, 2026. Shareholders adopted resolutions to increase the voting rights of Class B common shares from 5 to 100 votes per share and to amend the company's memorandum and articles of association accordingly. The meeting could be adjourned if insufficient votes existed. This is a routine governance matter, not a special situation event such as a merger, acquisition, or restructuring.
